scripts.prebuild: bun run validate-env && bun run registry:export
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bun run test:e2e:built
scripts.test:e2e:public: bun run build && bun run test:e2e:public:built
scripts.test:e2e:public:built: E2E_SERVER_MODE=production playwright test tests/e2e/route-matrix.spec.ts tests/e2e/route-open-source.spec.ts tests/e2e/a11y-structure.spec.ts --project=chromium --project=mobile-chromium --project=mobile-webkit
scripts.test:e2e:auth-scaffold: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL= NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY= NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY= bun run build && bun run test:e2e:auth-scaffold:built
scripts.test:e2e:auth-scaffold:built: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL= NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY= NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY= E2E_SERVER_MODE=production playwright test --project=auth-scaffold
scripts.test:e2e:authenticated-live: node scripts/validate-e2e-auth-env.mjs && LOEHRNING_VALIDATION_PROFILE=live-auth-e2e E2E_AUTH_LIVE=1 bun run build && bun run test:e2e:authenticated-live:built
scripts.test:e2e:authenticated-live:built: node scripts/validate-e2e-auth-env.mjs && E2E_AUTH_LIVE=1 E2E_SERVER_MODE=production playwright test --project=authenticated-live
scripts.test:e2e:release: RELEASE_VALIDATION=1 bun run build && bun run test:e2e:release:built
scripts.verify: bun run page-inventory:check && bun run test:env-contract && bun run test:e2e-auth-env-contract && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build
